CYP1A2 *1/*30 + *30/*30 (assigned as ultrarapid metabolizer and rapid metabolizer phenotype) is associated with decreased severity of Drug Toxicity when treated with pazopanib in people with Renal Cell Carcinoma, Leiomyosarcoma, Chronic myelogenous leukemia, BCR-ABL1 positive or Neoplasms as compared to CYP1A2 *1/*1 (assigned as normal metabolizer phenotype) .
Allele C is associated with increased likelihood of Hypertriglyceridemia when treated with pegaspargase in children with Acute lymphoblastic leukemia as compared to allele T.
